## Workload

During the review period, grader Tomas Brennan completed 876 reads, recording 446 hours of work. This represents an average of 2.0 reads per hour. The workload figures provide a summary of activity completed during the period and indicate the pace at which the reads were undertaken. They are recorded for review alongside the quality findings.

## Quality

A total of 49 reads were checked as part of the quality review. Agreement between the grader’s assessment and the review findings was 61.2 per cent. These results provide the basis for the quality assessment and should be considered together with the workload information. The review was completed by Priya Anand, who considered both the volume of work undertaken and the outcome of the checked reads. The findings are recorded for routine performance monitoring and follow-up.
